note: Skill descriptions and per-level effects from the Escape from Tarkov wiki's Character skills pages (Nov 2026), except where marked 'source: game config' or 'measured in game'. BSG changes skills between patches and does not publish the client-side effects, so check the wiki or the in-game skill tooltips if something looks off. When game data is loaded, only skills tarkov.dev lists as active in the game are shown. To correct values, copy this file to data/skills.json and edit it; the tracker prefers that copy.

skills.name: Endurance
skills.description: Endurance influences the amount of stamina and the rate of exhaustion while running or jumping, as well as holding and recovering breath.
skills.levelUp: Running, sprinting and moving while overweight.
elite: Stamina +20% more (+70% in total)
Increased arm endurance
Breathing no longer depends on energy

skills.name: Strength
skills.description: Increasing strength allows you to jump higher, sprint faster, hit harder, throw farther, and carry more weight.
skills.levelUp: Sprinting, jumping and moving while overweight, throwing grenades, melee hits.
elite: Weapons on the sling and on your back don't count towards your weight
+50% chance to deal critical melee damage

skills.name: Vitality
skills.description: Vitality improves your chances of surviving a wound by decreasing the possibility of bleeding and instant death through critical damage to a body part.
skills.levelUp: Taking damage, having a bleeding or a destroyed limb.

effects.name: Chance of death from losing a limb

elite: Faster health regeneration in combat
All bleedings stop on their own (light after 20 s, heavy after 30 s)

skills.name: Health
skills.description: Good health speeds up the recovery from the damage sustained in the raids, decreases the probability of fractures and lowers the energy and dehydration rate.
elite: Damage absorption

skills.name: Stress Resistance
skills.description: Stress resistance improves the chances of withstanding injury shock, shaking hands, and tremors.
skills.levelUp: Receiving damage and being in pain.
elite: Access to Berserk mode

skills.name: Metabolism
skills.description: Healthy metabolism improves and extends the effects of eating and drinking, and sustains the physical skills longer.

effects.name: Negative effect time of stimulants, food and drink

elite: No damage from exhaustion and dehydration

skills.name: Immunity
skills.description: Immunity affects the susceptibility to illnesses and the effectiveness of their treatment.
skills.levelUp: Being poisoned and taking stimulants with negative effects.

effects.name: Negative effects of stimulants, food and drink

elite: +90% chance to be immune to negative effects of stimulants, food and drink
+90% chance to be immune to poisons

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: Improves aiming concentration and makes detection of nearby loot easier.
elite: Loot proximity notification

skills.name: Intellect
skills.description: High intellect boosts the speed of item examination, lock picking, and improves the quality of weapon repairs.
skills.levelUp: Examining items and repairing weapons and armor.
elite: Ammo counter
Guess container contents without searching
No manual needed to examine items

skills.name: Attention
skills.description: Attention increases the looting speed of various containers.
elite: Double looting experience
+50% chance to find an item in a container instantly

skills.name: Charisma
skills.description: Mastering the art of charisma allows to receive discounts on various services.
elite: 10% discount on Scav Case prices
Fence standing penalty halved (applies at Scav karma 6+)
One more daily operational task
